verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a REST API and OAuth-based partner integration flow for contracts/payroll/people data and promotes getting 'integration in front of 40,000+ Deel customers', which supports embedding payroll functionality into a third-party product, but no evidence explicitly confirms a true white-label (Deel-branding-removed, reseller) program. Missing for 10: explicit white-label/reseller terms, branding customization docs, and independent confirmation of embedded payroll UI in partner products.
